title: Building Applications with Large Language Models
learning_outcomes: Explain the major concepts in Building Applications with Large Language Models and connect the numbered lesson topics.
Apply a representative technique or model the decision process using a transparent example.
Describe evaluation needs, assumptions, and risks relevant to the module.

overview_visual.alt_text: Two-column lesson roadmap for Module 13: Building Applications with Large Language Models. It lists 11 curriculum topics and ends with the workflow Observe, Experiment, Evaluate, Iterate.
overview_visual.caption: Module 13 visual roadmap: scan the ordered lesson cards, then use the Observe → Experiment → Evaluate → Iterate cycle when applying the concepts.

notes: All 11 lesson titles and their source subtopics are preserved from the AI.pdf syllabus. An AI application includes much more than a model call: data flow, validation, retrieval, access control, observability, and failure handling matter. The module is draft pending subject-matter review.
